title: Design Pattern Catalog Schema
description: Validates substrate-authored design-pattern catalogs under governance-commons/catalogs/design-patterns/. Design-pattern catalogs are review-cadence reference catalogs (not on the draft/stable rule lifecycle); they enumerate publicly-recognized design knowledge (SOLID, Gang of Four, Clean Code, Fowler, architecture and system-design patterns) as substrate-original paraphrase, keyed by a stable catalog-local id. The content is reference material an engineer or AI agent consults while designing; it is neither an L1/L2 enforceable check nor an L3 decision framework. This schema validates the shared structure (a metadata block plus a patterns collection) without constraining the per-pattern descriptive fields, which vary by pattern family. Schema is at draft lifecycle status; it rides to stable with its design-pattern-catalog consumers on a future cooling-off per the schema-rides-content precedent.

x-governance-commons.author: myoung
x-governance-commons.ai-assistance: AI drafted to realize the design-pattern catalog kind that catalog-format.md recognizes and that substrate-scope.md's size estimate projects (~80 rules across SOLID, GoF, Clean Code, Fowler smells). Modeled on threat-catalog.schema.json: a metadata block plus an item collection, validating shared structure only and leaving per-pattern descriptive fields open. The first three catalogs (solid, gang-of-four, architecture) were authored as substrate-original paraphrase of public design concepts; no upstream text or diagrams are reproduced.
x-governance-commons.validation-notes: Validated against the design-pattern catalogs in catalogs/design-patterns/ at authoring (2026-06-14). The schema requires a metadata block with catalog_id, catalog_name, and schema_version, and a patterns collection whose items each carry id and name. Top-level, metadata, and item additionalProperties are open to tolerate per-family descriptive fields (category, intent, when_to_use, consequences, avoid_when, also_known_as, related, applies_pattern_to, and similar). Promotion to stable follows the schema-rides-content Path A precedent: the schema flips draft to stable alongside a future design-pattern-catalog content event after the Charter cooling-off, with no schema content change expected.
